tooltips.transfer_to_ipod: Sync all selected tracks to Snake's iPod in Metal Gear Solid 4. This may take several minutes.
tooltips.waveform: Displays a visual representation of the selected track's audio waveform.
tooltips.codec: Displays the codec used to encode the selected track.
tooltips.bitrate: Displays the selected track's audio bitrate.
tooltips.channels: Displays the number of audio channels in the selected track.
tooltips.bitrate_mode: Displays whether the selected track uses constant or variable bitrate encoding.
tooltips.sample_rate: Displays the selected track's sampling rate, measured in samples per second.
tooltips.bit_depth: Displays the number of bits used to represent each audio sample.
tooltips.annotation: Displays additional information about the selected track, when available.
tooltips.filename: Displays the filename of the selected track.
tooltips.quality: Sets the output quality. Higher quality settings produce larger files. Choose a preset or adjust it manually.
tooltips.track_selection: Displays available tracks. Highlight a track to view details. Click to select or deselect it for syncing to Snake’s iPod.
tooltips.album_tabs: Displays available albums. Select an album to view its contents. Select ALL to view every track.
tooltips.select_all: Selects all tracks in the current list.
tooltips.select_none: Deselects all tracks in the current list.
tooltips.categories: Displays available track categories. Select a category to filter the tracklist.
